svg.text: DERIVED from AUTHORITATIVE · shoreline = edge of the ground model's constant water fill at 0.15 m RH2000 (20.9% of a 1400 m window) · 8233 shoreline cells at 1 m
5155 m² of 5155 m² — all of it
still short of 100 m — no corner escapes

The page called strandskydd “presumed”. It is measured: every square metre lies inside the 100 m zone, as does every registered building — and Värmdö’s WFS confirms no 300 m extension and no detaljplan.

rose overlay = land within 100 m of the shoreline (7 kap. 13–14 §§ miljöbalken) · white = registered boundary · gold = official footprints, labelled with distance to water · derived sha256 72359bd81cab55d26508c064…
